figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, becoming a disciple of the untruthful or dishonest
similar_in_english: Falling for a snake oil salesman
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো সবসময় মিথ্যাবাদীর নাড়া বাঁধা।
এই লোকটার কথায় নাড়া বাঁধলে পরে আফসোস হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always ties his nerves to a liar's cause.
If you tie your nerves to this con artist's words, you'll regret it later.
note: This idiom uses sarcasm to mock blind or foolish allegiance to deceitful figures.
